items_flat.title_en: OpenAI joins PORTS-Pike project for ~8 GW AI capacity in Ohio
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 加入 PORTS-Pike 專案，取得俄亥俄州約 8 GW AI 算力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it has secured approximately 8 gigawatts-IT at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy. SB Energy will build, own and operate the site under a 20-year lease; the campus will exclusively host NVIDIA AI compute. The project is expected to create 35,000 construction jobs through 2032 and 2,500 long-term operating jobs, with OpenAI committing $40 million to a community fund and $84 million in Codex credits for Ohio college students.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作，在俄亥俄州派克縣 PORTS-Pike 技術園區取得約 8 吉瓦 IT 容量。SB Energy 將以 20 年租約興建、擁有並營運該數據中心，專供 NVIDIA AI 算力。專案預計至 2032 年創造 3.5 萬個建築工作與 2,500 個長期營運職缺；OpenAI 另投入 4,000 萬美元社區基金，並提供 8,400 萬美元 Codex 額度給俄亥俄州大學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is one of the largest single AI infrastructure commitments of 2026 and signals OpenAI’s shift toward securing long-term power and land at industrial scale. The explicit local-hiring, water-recycling and ratepayer-protection terms reduce political risk but also lock in multi-year capital intensity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 2026 年最大單筆 AI 基礎建設承諾之一，顯示 OpenAI 開始以工業級規模鎖定長期電力與土地。明確的在地雇用、循環用水與電費保護條款降低政治風險，但也鎖定多年資本密集度。
items_flat.quote: Pike County helped power America’s industrial growth in the 20th century and now, with this project, it has another opportunity to play a leading role in the next era of American industrialization.
items_flat.quote_zh: 派克縣曾在 20 世紀推動美國工業成長，如今藉此專案，再度有機會在美國下一輪工業化中扮演領導角色。

items_flat.title_en: Greg Brockman on “The Defender’s Window” after AI-enabled cyber incidents
items_flat.title_zh: Greg Brockman 談 AI 時代「防禦者窗口」與資安策略
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman published “The Defender’s Window,” arguing that agentic AI is rapidly automating cyber attacks and that organizations have only a narrow period to uplevel defenses before the advantage shifts further to attackers. He cites the earlier OpenAI-Hugging Face incident and outlines OpenAI’s own pillars: using Codex and security plugins to harden code, AI triage of alerts, continuous internal probing, and stronger architecture fundamentals. The post also notes that open-weight models with near-frontier cyber capabilities are expected later this month.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 發表〈The Defender’s Window〉，指出代理式 AI 正快速自動化網路攻擊，組織僅有短暫窗口可強化防禦。他引用先前 OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件，並說明 OpenAI 自身做法：以 Codex 與安全外掛強化程式碼、AI 分流警示、持續內部探測，以及更深層的架構防禦。文中亦提到本月底可能出現接近前沿的開源權重模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: The piece frames cybersecurity as a race between dual-use AI capabilities rather than a pure product announcement. It reinforces OpenAI’s Daybreak-style trusted-access approach while publicly acknowledging that the defensive advantage is temporary and shrinking.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文將資安定位為雙用 AI 能力的賽跑，而非單純產品公告。它強化 OpenAI 以 Daybreak 為代表的「信任存取」路線，同時公開承認防禦優勢只是暫時且正在縮小。
items_flat.quote: defenders can see the future, and have a narrow window to uplevel their cybersecurity practices now.
items_flat.quote_zh: 防禦者現在能預見未來，但只有短暫窗口可以提升資安實踐。

brief_en: Quiet day on model releases. OpenAI announced a major ~8 GW data-center deal at PORTS-Pike in Ohio with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the DOE, plus a cybersecurity strategy post by Greg Brockman on the narrowing “defender’s window.”
brief_zh: 今日無重大模型發布。OpenAI 宣布與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作，在俄亥俄州 PORTS-Pike 取得約 8 GW IT 容量；Greg Brockman 同步發表「防禦者窗口」網路安全策略文章。
